_comment: Test the Claude prompt standalone. POST each test_input to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages. Validate response against expected.

tests.label: DNC — explicit stop request
tests.sms: Stop texting me. Remove me from your list.

tests.label: Not interested — polite decline
tests.sms: Thanks but we're not looking to sell right now.

tests.label: Not interested — firm
tests.sms: Not interested. Please don't reach out again.

tests.label: Maybe later — timing objection
tests.sms: Not ready yet but maybe in 6 months or so. Check back with me then.

tests.label: Maybe later — vague future
tests.sms: We might sell eventually but not anytime soon.

tests.label: Price fishing — valuation ask
tests.sms: What would you offer for it? Just curious what investors pay these days.

tests.label: Price fishing — market value ask
tests.sms: What do you think my house is worth?

tests.label: Interested — engaged, asking questions
tests.sms: Yeah I've been thinking about selling. How does your process work?

tests.label: Interested — open reply
tests.sms: Sure, I'm open to talking. When can you call?

tests.label: Motivated — life event
tests.sms: We're going through a divorce and need to sell the house. Trying to figure out our options.

tests.label: Motivated — behind on payments
tests.sms: I've been behind on my mortgage for a few months and really need to get out from under this.

tests.label: Urgent — foreclosure
tests.sms: I got a foreclosure notice and I have 30 days. Need to sell asap.

tests.label: Urgent — hard deadline
tests.sms: I need this sold before the end of the month. Already moved out.

tests.label: Ambiguous — question about who we are
